title: Profile list columns — Address, Representative, related Structure PN numbers
summary: Add Address, Representative information (with contacts), and Related Structure PN numbers to Profile list/Select Columns/CSV/PDF export. PN values are aggregated from linked structures (owner, tagged-by, matching tags).
